checks.name: Old and new IPC requests stay strict; paths, getters and extra fields cannot broaden a batch
File detail separates archive, parse, partial, empty and unavailable facts without reading originals
Issues paginate twenty at a time, before healthy files, with truthful filtered totals
Successfully parsed empty material is a terminal result, never permanent waiting
A local parse retry works with the external folder offline and touches only the selected saved item
Single archive retry admits only the selected failed row, preserving other failures and healthy resources
Batch local retry continues past one busy file, includes needs_ocr and partial, and skips healthy files
Unknown files, healthy rows and paths outside the saved grant cannot be retried
An offline original folder cannot authorize re-reading a failed archive
Failed local retry retains its reason; explicit successful retry clears only that reason

scope: Actual SQLite queries and local temporary files; retry queue host controlled, no AI/provider
